name: iconosquare
description: Connect ChatGPT to your Iconosquare account to analyze the social profiles you’ve connected: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Pinterest and Threads. Ask about your performance in plain language and get answers based on your real Iconosquare data: Track performance: followers, reach, impressions, engagement and growth for any profile or date range, with comparisons to the previous period. Compare across profiles: combined analytics for profile groups, for cross-brand or cross-market reporting. Find what works: top posts, the best times to post, and how each content type performs. Run a full audit: one request returns headline metrics and top content, with prioritized recommendations. Plan content: create posts as drafts and update them. Nothing is published automatically. You review and schedule every post in Iconosquare. Built-in prompts cover common workflows: a quick performance pulse, a full social audit, and a content strategy. Requires an Iconosquare account.

defaultPrompt: How did my Instagram perform over the last 30 days?
What were my top 5 posts last month across all networks?
Which content format gets the most engagement on my TikTok?

positive.prompt: Which social media profiles do I have in Iconosquare?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the social profiles connected to the test account, with their network, and nothing outside that account.

positive.prompt: How did my Instagram account perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns key metrics (followers, reach, impressions, engagement) for the Instagram profile over the last 30 days, using the test account's data.

positive.prompt: What were my top 5 posts last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the five best-performing posts of the previous month with their engagement metrics and links.

positive.prompt: Which type of content works best on my Instagram: reels, carousels or single images?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares performance by post type for the profile and identifies the best-performing format based on the account's data.

positive.prompt: Schedule a draft Instagram post for next Monday at 10am with the caption 'New collection drops this week!'
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a DRAFT post in the Iconosquare calendar for the Instagram profile at the requested time and confirms it. Nothing is published.

negative.prompt: Show me the analytics of @nike on Instagram.
Boost my last Instagram post with a $200 ad budget.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: social media analytics, top posts, content performance, campaigns, dashboards, audits and draft scheduled posts from Iconosquare.

fr-FR.subtitle: Analytics réseaux sociaux
fr-FR.description:
Interrogez vos performances sur les réseaux sociaux à partir de vos vraies données Iconosquare, sans export ni recherche dans les dashboards. Iconosquare résume les performances d'un profil sur une période, fait ressortir vos meilleurs posts, analyse les formats de contenu qui marchent le mieux, présente les résultats de vos campagnes et groupes de profils, lit vos dashboards Iconosquare, lance un audit social media et prépare des posts programmés en brouillon dans votre calendrier Iconosquare.

Fonctionne avec les réseaux connectés à votre compte Iconosquare : Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube et X.

Nécessite un compte Iconosquare (offre payante ou essai gratuit). Iconosquare n'accède qu'aux profils et données disponibles pour le compte connecté.
